title: Settings
overview: This guide covers settings workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Account Settings
subtasks.purpose: Review personal account details, change session timeout, toggle two-factor authentication and clear browser cache.

steps.title: Open Account Settings
steps.description: Click Settings in the left sidebar.

steps.title: View Default Tab
steps.description: The Account Setting tab is selected by default.

steps.title: Review Account Fields
steps.description: Review the read-only fields: Full Name, Username, Email, Phone, Fax, Current Session Time.

steps.title: Update Session Timeout
steps.description: To change how long a session stays alive when idle, enter a new value in Session Time (minutes) and click Update.

steps.title: Toggle Two-Factor Auth
steps.description: Click the red Two Way Authentication chip to enable / disable 2FA (the label toggles between Enabled and Disabled).

steps.title: Refresh Cached Data
steps.description: Click Refresh next to Clear Cache to purge locally cached data if pages appear stale. Notes Session Time controls the automatic sign-out window — reducing it improves security on shared workstations. When 2FA is enabled, subsequent sign-ins require a one-time code delivered via email. Fields shown as Not Available (e.g. Fax) can be filled in from the user profile in the Permission → Users flow.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Setting
subtasks.purpose: Configure the default thresholds and cadence that drive the Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query.

steps.title: Open Follow-Up Setting
steps.description: Click Settings, then the Follow Up Setting tab.

steps.title: Set Follow-Up Thresholds
steps.description: Set the default thresholds (e.g. minimum days since last upload, minimum readings) that flag a patient for follow-up.

steps.title: Set Recontact Cadence
steps.description: Set the default recontact cadence and any escalation window.

steps.title: Save Follow-Up Setting
steps.description: Click Save to apply. Notes These values pre-populate the Follow Up Query filters but can be overridden per-query.

subtasks.title: Calendar Permission Settings
subtasks.purpose: Control which roles can view, book on, or manage the calendar.

steps.title: Open Calendar Permissions
steps.description: Click Settings, then the Calendar Permission Settings tab.

steps.title: Set Role Calendar Actions
steps.description: For each role, tick the calendar actions to allow (View, Book, Reschedule, Cancel, Manage Working Hours, Manage Visit Types).

steps.title: Save Calendar Permissions
steps.description: Click Save. Notes These settings layer on top of the general role permissions from the Permission module — the calendar honours whichever is more restrictive. Task 6.11 — Permission (Role-Based Access)
